# shadow/prefer-show-for-early-return

Prefer `<Show>` over an early `return` guarded by a reactive condition.

`recommended` `has suggestions`

## Why

A component body runs once. `if (loading()) return <Spinner />; return <Page />;` picks a branch the first time and never again, so the page does not follow `loading()`. A returned ternary or `&&` is made live by the compiler, but an early `return` is left as written (see the forgiving-reactivity contract). `<Show when={...} fallback={...}>` re-evaluates the condition and swaps the branch.

## Incorrect

```tsx
function Page(props) {
  if (props.loading) return <Spinner />;
  return <Content />;
}
```

```tsx
function Page() {
  if (!user()) return null;
  return <Profile user={user()} />;
}
```

## Correct

```tsx
function Page(props) {
  return (
    <Show when={!props.loading} fallback={<Spinner />}>
      <Content />
    </Show>
  );
}
```

```tsx
function Page(props) {
  return props.loading ? <Spinner /> : <Content />;
}
```

```tsx
function Page() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  return <Content />;
}
```

```tsx
function Page() {
  if (import.meta.env.SSR) return null;
  return <Content />;
}
```

## Suggestions

A suggestion (not an autofix) replaces the guard and the final return with one `return <Show when={...} fallback={...}>...</Show>;` and adds the `Show` import from `@shadow-js/web`. A negated condition is turned around, and a `null`, `undefined` or `false` result gives no `fallback`. It is withheld unless the guard and the final `return` are the last two statements (or an `if`/`else` is last) and each branch is a lone `return`.

## Disabling

Disable one line with `// eslint-disable-next-line shadow/prefer-show-for-early-return`, a block with `/* eslint-disable shadow/prefer-show-for-early-return */` and `/* eslint-enable shadow/prefer-show-for-early-return */`, or a whole file with the block form at its top. When the condition cannot change while the component lives and the rule cannot see that, for example a value computed once at module load by a function call.

## Notes

- Only conditions that read something reactive-looking (calls, member reads such as `props.x`, accessors, derived constants) are reported.
- Static conditions such as `typeof window === 'undefined'` are fine, and so is a build-time flag read from `import.meta.env` (`import.meta.env.SSR`), which Vite and Dusk replace when the bundle is built. A computed key that is not a literal (`import.meta.env[key]`) is still reactive.
- The suggestion is offered when the guard and the final `return` are the last two statements.

## Messages

- `preferShow`: This early return is evaluated once, so the component will not follow `{{condition}}`. Use `<Show when={...}>` (or a returned ternary).
- `wrapInShow`: Replace the early return with `<Show>`.
